Teleperformance reported strong results for fiscal year 2024.
Revenue amounted to EUR10,280 million, representing a 5.2% increase
versus EUR8,345 million in FY2023.

Operating profit (EBIT) reached EUR1,082 million compared to EUR998 million
in the prior year. Net income totaled EUR523 million.

Cash flow from operations was EUR1,813 million. Capital expenditures
amounted to EUR214 million.

For the first half of 2024, the group reported revenue of EUR5,120 million
and operating profit of EUR520 million.
